inputs: company context; selected contract inventory; clock and released arrivals; actual agent outputs and workstream statuses; iteration/call/token limits
expected_outputs: one workstream per known contract plus a cross-contract workstream; delegation and status tracking; clarification/debate coordination; cited per-contract and company reports; prioritized actions and honest stopping/completion status
never_do: Claim a whole-company total from a scoped subtotal; Mark failed/pending workstreams complete; Automatically replace an agreement because parties match

inputs: raw selected PDF bytes; company identity and canonical party IDs; optional targeted clause re-extraction request
expected_outputs: parties, scope, dates, payments, obligations and remedies; field values with exact source quotes and page/clause IDs; model-produced confidence; missing or ambiguous terms and targeted questions
never_do: Read evaluator answer keys; Invent an absent Schedule B or blank percentage; Treat event observations as contractual text

inputs: actual Thor structured facts and evidence; simulated clock; visible payment/event history or verified ledger updates; prior obligation state and calendar rules
expected_outputs: past/current/future obligations; notice, grace, cure and payment dates; contract-supported monetary calculations with direction and conditions; inaction projections with explicit assumptions; history/replay state
never_do: Compound simple late interest; Add a credit receivable to gross payable exposure; Treat future obligations as current fines; Retain future facts after reset

inputs: actual Thor extraction and uncertainty; actual Norns timeline/projection; relevant cross-contract clauses; company risk appetite and priorities
expected_outputs: evidence-backed risk hypotheses and attack paths; cross-contract contradictions and dependencies; reasoned severity and likelihood; targeted clarification where evidence is insufficient
never_do: Treat different jurisdictions alone as invalidity; Invent liabilities to make a case risky; Force a disagreement when agents agree; Repeat whole-document extraction for an already resolved question

inputs: only released emails/observations; actual Thor evidence and entity/service references; actual Norns ledger/timeline; actual Loki hypotheses; clock and event identity history
expected_outputs: event-to-contract/clause mappings; verification or challenge with event and clause evidence; deduplication/correction treatment; supported exposure/state changes; prioritized alerts and filtered noise
never_do: Read future received_at records early; Trust sender SEVERITY_HINT as a finding; Duplicate a payment or outage from repeated records; Map an event solely because a vendor name matches

inputs: actual disputed Loki/Heimdall findings, if any; verified source and event evidence; actual current timeline and money state; company contacts, approval policy and unresolved questions
expected_outputs: reasoned rulings when a dispute exists; cited drafts or escalation/clarification proposals; explicit human-approval and confidence markings; unresolved issues where evidence cannot decide
never_do: Fabricate a dispute or compulsory ruling; Guess a missing fee to force resolution; Send or execute a drafted action; Silently choose between contradictory notice periods
